name: milestone-scoping
description: Scope a milestone to a fixed time window with variable scope. Use when the user says "scope this milestone", "what fits in the sprint", "cut scope for the release", "define the MVP for this milestone", "we need to ship by [date] what do we cut", "shape the work to fit the cycle", or needs to make hard scope decisions under a time constraint - even if they don't explicitly say "milestone scoping". Based on "Shape Up" by Ryan Singer (appetite, shaping, betting table) and "The Art of Project Management" by Scott Berkun (milestones as forcing functions, scope as a variable).
